purpose: FRONTERA supplier acquisition tracker. A program lead is not an approval, and a listed affiliate program does not mean FRONTERA has permission to promote the supplier.

status_definitions.active-approved: FRONTERA has confirmed approval and can use the program subject to its terms.
status_definitions.application-ready: Official supplier page identifies an affiliate application route; FRONTERA still needs to apply and be approved.
status_definitions.network-review: Program appears to be available through a network; confirm it is visible and open to FRONTERA's publisher account before applying.
status_definitions.research-lead: Potential supplier; current direct affiliate access or feed availability is not sufficiently confirmed.

suppliers.name: TopOak Overland
